SELECT p.id, p.title, p.content, p.images, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.view_count, p.created_at, u.id AS author_id, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar AS author_avatar, c.name AS category_name FROM post p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.author_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.status = 1 AND p.category_id = #{categoryId} AND p.author_id = #{authorId} ORDER BY
p.like_count DESC, p.created_at DESC p.created_at DESC

SELECT t.* FROM ( SELECT p.id, p.title, p.content, p.images, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.view_count, p.created_at, u.id AS author_id, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar AS author_avatar, c.name AS category_name, (6371 * ACOS(LEAST(1.0, GREATEST(-1.0, COS(RADIANS(#{latitude})) * COS(RADIANS(p.latitude)) * COS(RADIANS(p.longitude) - RADIANS(#{longitude})) + SIN(RADIANS(#{latitude})) * SIN(RADIANS(p.latitude)))))) AS distance FROM post p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.author_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.status = 1 AND p.longitude IS NOT NULL AND p.latitude IS NOT NULL
AND p.latitude BETWEEN #{latitude} - (#{radius} / 111) AND #{latitude} + (#{radius} / 111) AND ((#{radius} / (111 * GREATEST(ABS(COS(RADIANS(LEAST(90, ABS(#{latitude}) + #{radius} / 111)))), 0.000000001))) >= 180 OR ABS(p.longitude - #{longitude}) <= (#{radius} / (111 * GREATEST(ABS(COS(RADIANS(LEAST(90, ABS(#{latitude}) + #{radius} / 111)))), 0.000000001))) OR ABS(p.longitude - #{longitude}) >= 360 - (#{radius} / (111 * GREATEST(ABS(COS(RADIANS(LEAST(90, ABS(#{latitude}) + #{radius} / 111)))), 0.000000001)))) AND p.category_id = #{categoryId} ) t WHERE t.distance <= #{radius} ORDER BY t.distance ASC

SELECT p.id, p.title, p.content, p.images, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.view_count, p.created_at, u.id AS author_id, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar AS author_avatar, c.name AS category_name FROM post p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.author_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.status = 1 AND MATCH(p.title, p.content) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE) AND p.category_id = #{categoryId} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT p.id, p.title, p.content, p.images, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.view_count, p.created_at, u.id AS author_id, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar AS author_avatar, c.name AS category_name FROM post_favorite pf JOIN post p ON pf.post_id = p.id LEFT JOIN user u ON p.author_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE pf.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 1 ORDER BY pf.created_at DESC
